content:
**FOnline: New Dawn** began with the FOnline: Aftertimes engine as its foundation. Over time, however, we rebuilt and improved so much of the server that very little of the original remains. Our work has focused on creating a scalable, efficient platform capable of supporting the game for years to come.

Every major mechanic was designed and implemented from the ground up. We drew on years of experience with other FOnline servers to preserve the ideas that made the genre compelling, rethink those that did not, and build our own solutions around them. We did not use source code from any other publicly available server. Particular care has gone into the design of combat systems, character classes and the way they interact.

**PvP is at the heart of New Dawn.** Player conflict will drive both the economy and many of the server's events. PvE content will remain an important part of the world, with a special emphasis on **PvPvE** encounters where players, factions and the environment collide.

We believe combat should be clear, competitive and fair. Random critical hits and obscure, poorly explained mechanics have no place here. Our goal is to make victory feel earned through preparation, decision-making and skill — not won through gambling on an unpredictable roll.

**Coming soon.** We plan to begin with a beta test season focused on gathering meaningful feedback from players. It will be shorter than the standard seasons we have planned, but also more intensive. Development throughout the beta will follow a weekly patch cycle, allowing us to respond quickly, make effective use of the limited season time and improve the game alongside the community.

**New Dawn will be completely free to play.** We will not sell power, conveniences, skins, event access or any other in-game content. Money will provide no gameplay advantage and will not unlock experiences unavailable to other players. Everyone enters the wasteland on equal terms.
